cause: Unity's generated requestPointerLock call ignored the browser Promise; cancellation reached the global unhandled-rejection handler.
changes: Catch cancellation at the canvas pointer-lock request, including Promise and event-only browser implementations.
Deduplicate pending lock requests and wait for a trusted click after cancellation.
Pause the game when mouse capture is declined or released; discard the capture click.
Avoid redundant Cursor assignments and prevent the same Esc event from immediately resuming/re-requesting capture.

checks.node: SecurityError cancellation, duplicate requests, Esc release, trusted retry, synchronous denial, event-only implementation, inactive user activation and unsupported browser passed; no unhandled rejection.
checks.unityPlayMode: 6 suites passed, including cursor-release pause and reload preservation plus all prior weapon/campaign regressions.
checks.browser: In-app browser denied pointer lock with WrongDocumentError; the game recovered to the pause screen, getJsDialog returned undefined and no error-level logs were produced.
